name: Rockpile
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A small AVA in the northwestern part of Sonoma County, beside Lake Sonoma, with about ⟦area|160 acres|65 hectares⟧ of vines at or above ⟦elev|800 feet|240 m⟧. It overlaps the northwestern corner of the Dry Creek Valley appellation and part of Northern Sonoma.
